_sources.discrepancies: [2026-06-10] Primary June 2, 2026 and general Nov 3, 2026 confirmed (FVAP; NM SoS). Updated sameDayRegistration to true: New Mexico offers same-day registration at county clerk offices, at some early voting sites, and at the polls on Election Day (NM SoS voter-registration FAQ) - the file previously said false. Standard (online/mail) registration deadline is 28 days before the election (May 5 / Oct 6, 2026). Early voting: May 5-30, 2026 (primary) and Oct 6-31, 2026 (general); expanded early voting sites open later in the window - confirm locations with your county clerk. Added per-election registration and earlyVoting blocks that were previously missing.

earlyVoting.notes: Early in-person voting for the June 2, 2026 primary ran May 5-30, 2026, beginning at county clerk offices (expanded sites open later in the window). Same-day registration is available at early voting sites and on Election Day.

Early in-person voting runs October 6-31, 2026, beginning at county clerk offices (expanded locations open later in the window). Same-day registration is available. Find locations: https://voterportal.servis.sos.nm.gov/WhereToVote.aspx
Early voting for the general election runs October 6-31, 2026 at county clerk offices and expanded early voting locations. Same-day registration available.

votingRules.phonesAtPollsDetail: Phones are permitted at New Mexico polling places.
additionalRules: Voters without ID may vote by affidavit

primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEn: New Mexico has a closed primary (NMSA §1-8-16). Only voters registered with a political party may vote in that party's primary. Independent and unaffiliated voters are not permitted to vote in partisan primary elections.
primaryParticipation.ruleExplanationEs: Nuevo México tiene una primaria cerrada (NMSA §1-8-16). Solo los votantes registrados en un partido político pueden votar en la primaria de ese partido. Los votantes independientes y sin afiliación no pueden votar en primarias partidistas.
